Title: WHALES similarity search on 600k molecules from Q-Mug
Description: Searches a reference collection of roughly 600,000 molecules for the 100 closest to a query, using WHALES descriptors so that similarity is judged by the distribution of charge across three-dimensional shape rather than by shared substructures. This makes the search suited to scaffold hopping, where the aim is to find compounds presenting comparable interaction patterns on an unrelated skeleton. Because the descriptors depend on conformation, retrieved neighbours reflect the geometries used to build the index.
Interpretation: List of the 100 most shape and charge similar molecules from a 600,000-compound reference set.
